en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway line curving through a rural landscape toward a small town. A steam locomotive runs along the tracks on the left, with telegraph poles beside the line and fenced grassy fields in the foreground. In the background rises a prominent church with a tall spire among trees and low town buildings. Red printed captions in Swedish appear at the top: one on the left describing the scene from the railway and one on the right naming the town, Mariestad.
